script.source: Shipped GOB 184 is a toggle with a 25 IS activation cost, five-second reuse and ISDrainWithAbilityDeactivation of 25 every five seconds. SpeedingInit and SpeedingTerm in research/client-scripts/tempmods.py set and clear only 0x0400. The old sniffer Unknown capture at 17:33:01 includes the four modifier removals, exclusive OFF and localized c60020b4 on shortfall.
script.runtime: The guarded activation charges the drain, leaves IS untouched on shortfall, removes its records and presentation and starts reuse. Manual toggle-off also clears the movement effect and cancels the old drain. The owner and watcher updates preserve the remaining movement state.
script.test: BuffDrainLifetimeTests covers equality, shortfall, record removal and persistence of another speed buff. The ability-parity-awakened-hyper-sprint disposable uses the complete stock request from 11701b9dd84e and covers activation, a real timed debit, manual off, restart, natural shortfall and owner/watcher resets.
